## How I checked it

<!-- Tests, the headless screenshots, a real card or file. Say what you measured. -->

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] `scripts/bundle.sh` builds and the app launches
- [ ] Originals are never written; any new write goes to a temporary name first
- [ ] What a person will see is a line under the unreleased section of [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md), or this changes nothing visible
- [ ] A decision that is hard to undo has an entry in [docs/DECISIONS.md](../docs/DECISIONS.md)
- [ ] Screenshots show no personal photos or captions
